crossRefs.note: But Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked. You have grown fat. You have grown thick. You have become sleek. Then he abandoned…
If you forsake Yahweh, and serve foreign gods, then he will turn and do you evil, and consume you, after he has done…
Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them; for the deeds of his hands will be paid back to him.
Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain…
Yahweh will bring you, and your king whom you will set over yourselves, to a nation that you have not known, you nor…
Surely now they will say, “We have no king; for we don’t fear Yahweh; and the king, what can he do for us?”

translations.web: But if you keep doing evil, you will be consumed, both you and your king.”
translations.bsb: But if you persist in doing evil, both you and your king will be swept away.”
translations.kjv: But if ye shall still do wickedly, ye shall be consumed, both ye and your king.
translations.asv: But if ye shall still do wickedly, ye shall be consumed, both ye and your king.
